escena: SCENE (cinematic still, a dark studio at night): a close group portrait of THREE small friendly robot agents, each the size of a football, round glossy white bodies with navy panels and big expressive azure-blue LED eyes, with comic, cheerful faces, standing together on a dark polished table and looking straight into the lens: the one in the centre waves at the camera, the one on the left holds up a tiny glowing card, the one on the right gives a thumbs-up. Their LED eyes are the main light sources and glow intensely; a soft teal (#36C8BF) rim light from behind outlines their round bodies; light haze. Realistic materials: glossy plastic with tiny scratches, visible seams and screws, real reflections on the table. COMPOSITION FOR A CIRCULAR CROP: everything important stays inside the central circle of the square; the four corners are only dark empty space.  Rich contrast, punchy saturated colour, real photographic detail and texture (dust, micro-scratches, real depth of field), no text, no readable letters or numbers, no logos of any other brand.
